full_text:
An unnamed Titan is a tall avian humanoid with the head of an ibis. It wears an orange and gold Egyptian ceremonial garb and has long thin limbs and talons, from which it casts a mystical purple aura. Its Amulet is in the possession of Lok Lambert.

== History ==
Lok Lambert uses this Titan to helps him break difficult codes that he can't break on his own. [TCG:SAS-108]

== Abilities ==
This Titan is able to read, interpret and unlock ancient magical scripts and is adept at deciphering and breaking complex codes. [TCG:SAS-108]

== Gallery ==

Decoding_-_Unnamed_Titan_Icon.jpg|Unnamed Titan 007's Icon

== Trivia ==
*This Titan's appearance is based on Thoth, the Egyptian god of writing and knowledge, characterized by having the head of an ibis.
